integrity: The proof uses explicit characteristic-seven Cartier coefficients, a rank-one semilinear iteration, and exact modular elimination. Two reproducibility programs cross-check the coefficients, identities, ranks and finite rational samples; finite checks are not used as infinite-field proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact coefficient-parameter stratification over an algebraic closure in characteristic seven; does not count isomorphism classes or compute complete Newton polygons. The five-point locus and Hasse multiplicities are algebraically proved but have no independent external audit.
title: Five zero-rank Pryms in the characteristic-seven genus-four \(C_6\) family
